fact: _handle_call_tool delegates to MCPServer.call_tool and ToolManager.call_tool, which looks up the tool by name then runs it with convert_result=True.
Input ValidationError is wrapped as ToolError before tool execution; _handle_call_tool returns it as CallToolResult with is_error=True and logs only rejected field names.
An explicit ToolError returns an is_error result carrying its text; unexpected exceptions become UnexpectedToolError with generic client-safe text while details are logged server-side.
MCPError bypasses the tool-result error conversion and is re-raised as a top-level protocol error.
